blocks.text: Solvent ke zariye kisi mixture ko us ke components mein alag karne ki technique ko paper chromatography kehte hain. Is mein alag hone ka usool components ki relative solubility (aik doosre ke muqable mein kitna ghulte hain) par hai. Chromatography mein istemal hone wale kaghaz mein paani hota hai jo kaghaz ke cellulose ke saath juda hota hai. Capillary tube (bohat patli nali) se sample ka chhota sa dhabba (spot) kaghaz ke neeche ke qareeb base line par lagaya jata hai. Phir kaghaz ko kisi munasib solvent mein duboya jata hai, jo kaghaz mein oopar charhta hai. Solvent ki satah sample ke dhabbe se neeche honi chahiye. Sample ke solutes (ghulne wali cheezein) solvent mein mukhtalif had tak ghulte hain. Kuch solvent (mobile phase) mein zyada ghulte hain aur kaghaz par oopar chale jate hain. Doosre kaghaz mein phanse paani (stationary phase) mein behtar ghulte hain, is liye kaghaz par zyada oopar nahi jate. Solubility ka yahi farq sample ke components ko alag kar deta hai.

blocks.alt: Dhakkan wala tank; kaghaz ki sheet solvent mein latki hai. Sample ka dhabba baseline par hai, tajurbe ke shuru mein solvent ki satah se oopar. Is ke oopar teen alag ajza A, B aur C, tooti lakeer wale solvent front se neeche. Labels: lid, solvent front, components, baseline, solvent level at the start of experiment, solvent.
blocks.caption: Figure 28.2: Paper chromatography (kitab ki Figure 28.2 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.text: Chromatography se rangeen aur be-rang dono qism ki cheezein alag ki jati hain. Be-rang cheezon par locating agent (aisa spray jo unhein rang de deta hai) chhirka jata hai taa ke woh nazar aa jayein.

Kisi substance ki Rf value (Retardation factor ya Retention factor) is tarah nikalte hain: component ne jitna faasla tay kiya, usay solvent ke tay kiye hue faasle se divide karein (dono faasle baseline se nape jate hain).

blocks.latex: R_f = \frac{\text{Distance traveled by the substance}}{\text{Distance traveled by the solvent}}
blocks.text_alt: Rf = maadde ka tay kiya hua faasla / solvent ka tay kiya hua faasla

blocks.text: Rf ki koi unit nahi hoti kyunke yeh ratio (do faaslon ka hissa) hai. Aik jaise halaat (wahi solvent aur wahi temperature) mein kisi substance ki Rf value nahi badalti. Chromatography ka aik faida yeh hai ke is mein mixture ki bohat thori miqdar lagti hai.

blocks.alt: Tayyar kaghaz ki patti: neeche ki lakeer par starting point, oopar aik dhabba, aur oopar ke qareeb solvent front. Saath mein X starting point se dhabbe tak ka faasla aur Y starting point se solvent front tak ka faasla hai.
blocks.caption: Figure 28.3: Dhabbe aur solvent front ka faasla napna (kitab ki Figure 28.3 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Rf = X / Y: X starting point se dhabbe tak aur Y starting point se solvent front tak ka faasla hai. Dhabba kabhi solvent front se aage nahi jata, is liye Rf hamesha 1 se kam hota hai.

blocks.prompt: Rf value kabhi 1 se zyada kyun nahi ho sakti?
blocks.explanation: Substance solvent ke saath hi chalta hai, is liye solvent front se aage nahi ja sakta: X hamesha Y se kam ya barabar hota hai.

blocks.prompt: Baseline pencil se kyun banayi jati hai, aur solvent ki satah dhabbon se neeche kyun honi chahiye?
blocks.explanation: Pencil (graphite) solvent mein nahi ghulti, jab ke roshnai ghul kar phail jati. Agar solvent dhabbon ko dhak le to sample kaghaz par oopar charhne ki bajaye seedha tank ke solvent mein ghul jayega.

items: Paper chromatography: stationary phase = kaghaz mein paani; mobile phase = solvent.
Components apni relative solubility ke farq se alag hote hain; be-rang cheezein locating agent se nazar aati hain.
Rf = substance ka faasla / solvent ka faasla; koi unit nahi; aik jaise halaat mein Rf nahi badalti.
